description.text: Grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Red XIII], [Cosmo Memory Damage Tracker] and [Cosmo Memory Level]

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Red XIII
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Cosmo Memory (0~2), removed after using Cosmo Memory two times

description.name: Cosmo Memory Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Cosmo Memory level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Red XIII]

description.name: Cosmo Memory Level
description.text: Keeps track of Cosmo Memory level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Red XIII]
